title: Basic bijections and source-arrow squares for supported comparison
statement: For the native supported Hom models, exact etale-to-pro-etale comparison is bijective on supported, ordinary and open classes. It commutes with forget-support and open restriction, the two maps induced by the source coefficient sequence.

source.place: Tag 099V, lemma-relative-comparison, through the existing bounded-below finite-coefficient derived comparison theorem thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison. The two coefficient-source squares are the defining normalization squares of the native supported and open comparison isomorphisms; see the supported localization sequence in Stacks Tag 09XP.

proof.text: Conjugate the fully faithful exact derived comparison Hom map by the specified single, shift and endpoint isomorphisms. This gives the three bijections. Exact inverse image preserves precomposition. The defining restriction-normalized source comparison and inclusion-normalized open comparison squares then give the two source-arrow equations.

proof_origin.place: Native normalized-Hom consequence of thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison; source-arrow squares from the constructions in def-pur-supported-cup-functoriality-models.

from.place: Step 7: Hom bijections and the two source arrows
